authority_boundary.interpretation_rule: Humans may use this packet to record an attributable governance disposition. No automated system can treat this packet as an approval; g1_approved remains false until a separately recorded human disposition binds the exact D1/D2 identities in this packet.

presentation_context.note: Presentation bindings only. Does not invent human approval. D1/D2 landed_on SHAs remain the merge identities where those artifacts first existed on main.

human_g1_approval_record.attribution_requirement: Any system (including future tooling) must treat g1_approved=true as possible only when an attributable human governance record is separately committed and bound to the exact D1 and D2 identities/digests in artifacts_introduced_in_recovery.

remaining_unresolved_conditions_blocking: No attributable human governance disposition has been recorded for the exact D1/D2 identity binding in this recovery (this packet therefore keeps g1_approved=false).

Any PRE-G2 lineage selection and S2 binding must remain UNKNOWN until an externally selected PRE-G2 workbench lineage is bound via its public provenance fields; this packet does not provide that lineage identity.
non_claims: This packet does not authorize G1, G2, publication, canonical mutation, or any successor execution.
